```{r}
url <- "https://miamioh.edu/policy-library/students/undergraduate/academic-regulations/index.html"

page <- rvest::read_html(url)

raw_links <- page |> 
  rvest::html_elements("main a") |> 
  rvest::html_attr("href")

mu_policies <- xml2::url_absolute(raw_links, base = url)

mu_policies <- mu_policies[stringr::str_detect(mu_policies, "/academic-regulations/")]

print(mu_policies)
```


```{r}


library(rvest)
library(dplyr)

url <- "https://miamiredhawks.com/sports/swimming-and-diving/roster"

page <- rvest::read_html(url)

swim_df <- page |>
  rvest::html_elements(
    "a[data-test-id='s-person-details__personal-single-line-person-link']"
  ) |>
  lapply(function(player) {

    name <- player |>
      rvest::html_element("h3") |>
      rvest::html_text2()

    year <- player |>
      rvest::html_element(
        "div.s-person-details__bio-stats.s-text-details-bold.py-0\.5"
      ) |>
      rvest::html_text2()

    data.frame(
      name = name,
      year = year,
    )
  }) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows()

```
